To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of Web assisted education in the Turkish Language Education is effective in the development of students’ academic success and attitudes.
Web Assisted Education is a more successful teaching method in the field of Turkish Language Education than the traditional teaching methods.
The Web Assisted Education based on constructivism approach is more effective in the academic achievement, attitudes and skills of the pre-service Turkish teachers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of web-assisted education on the pre-service Turkish teachers.

the effect of Web-Assisted education based on constructivist approaches on Turkish pre-service teachers' academic achievement and attitudes toward to the lesson in the subject of Instructional Technologies and Materials Design.
the effect of the Web-Assisted Education method on Turkish language pre-service teachers’ academic achievement and attitudes towards the subject, computer and lesson.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the web assisted education is an effective method in teaching and learning process.
Web Assisted Education based on constructivist method is an effective method in the teaching of the subjects and it is more effective on students than teacher centered education.
the Web Assisted Education based on Constructivism is more effective in the field of “Instructional Technologies And Material Design”.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Web assisted education based on constructivist method was more effective in terms of academic achievements and attitudes of the pre-service Turkish teachers than the teacher centered education.

the use of web-assisted education in the Turkish Language Teaching lesson is more effective in the academic achievements of the students and in the attitudes of the students towards the computer and the lesson.

the web assisted education based on constructivist teaching approach is more effective than teacher centered education on pre-service Turkish teacher’s academic achievements and attitudes towards to computer and lesson.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can make the most of the time we spend with our students by making sure that they have the right tools to learn.
it is possible to use Web Assisted Education in the classroom to improve student performance and engagement.

the Web is not a panacea for education but it is a tool that, if used wisely and in a manner consistent with the constructivist approach, can have a positive effect on the learning of pre-service Turkish teachers.
